Google EarthVirtual London 22.08.2006 1 min read

Google Earth London Placemark Movie (SoundTrack Test)

Andy CASA, UCL East

The movie was created whilst examining the models performance with various placemarks, in this case the London Tube stations of Bank, Barbican, Euston, Waterloo and Kings Cross.




The model streams in nicely although some slow down is evident in places. We might be out of the park on this one but we added a Trance soundtrack as it was all a bit dull without audio.

Not sure if it works but still, its just an experiment in soundtracks to Google Earth, if anyone else knows of a Google Earth movie with a good soundtrack (apart from from Jason Dancing..which if you havent seen it is neat, although not as good as the genius that is Where the Hell is Matt) let us know..

A higher resolution version can be downloaded here (.wmv 46Mb)
